newsitem.title: USA: NYSE lifts curbs on index-arbitrage trades.
newsitem.headline: NYSE lifts curbs on index-arbitrage trades.

text.p: The Dow industrials came off their highs in trading ahead of midday, prompting the NYSE to lift curbs on index-arbitrage trades at 1107 EDT/1507 GMT.
The Dow's early rally was driven almost exclusively by strength in shares of International Business Machines Corp, which last night reported better-than-forecast earnings.
Aside from IBM, up 9-3/4 at 152-1/8, no Dow stock was up more than fractionally, while several were down over a point.
The Dow was up 3 points at 6816, while Nasdaq was up one at 1229.
